ownership.argument: Astrolink binds this as the entry that pushes work to the Feature runtime thread. The handle is the Feature instance; the runtime object is reached through handle+28 then +12.

provenance.source: Names itself 'FeaturePost' in its own detached/null-handle logs at feature line 331; checks the handle's detached flag at handle+19 and, when attached, forwards to 0xC865D30(*(*(handle+28)+12), handle, a2, a3, a4). 4 call sites.
